tools.name: BioMCP
tools.license: MIT; returned source data retain their own terms
tools.documented_capability: Published CLI/MCP source retrieval, explicit entity-versus-relational routing, source-labelled records and bounded workflow playbooks.
tools.demonstrated_here: Pinned native binary version/help and one excluded manual source preflight qualified. PubMed-only candidate and enrichment-source plans were checked; the native ols4 source-disable flag suppresses optional keyword-suggestion calls.
tools.verified_gap: PubMed article source selection alone did not suppress ontology suggestion traffic in the excluded native preflight; source-disable is required for the fixed provider scope.
tools.decision: Use the small published PubMed retrieval surface and an attributed procedure adaptation in a separately controlled research comparison. Do not import the whole data catalogue or claim retrieval establishes biological truth.

additional_reviewed_snapshot.role: Source review only; not the executed comparison binary.

tools.name: K-Dense Scientific Agent Skills
tools.documented_capability: Ontology identity/lifecycle checks and evidence-bounded appraisal procedures; the selected ontology scripts are Python3.11+ standard-library clients.
tools.demonstrated_here: Selected sources were staged, not globally installed. The unchanged ontology validator was exercised on two already exposed historical GO display-label records; strict warnings/failures remained conservative.
tools.verified_gap: OLS detail and search representations expose different synonym-scope information, and native replacement values need not be full IRIs. The helper is a source-currency/identifier aid, not a biological truth judge.
tools.decision: Reuse qualified procedures and existing deterministic scripts within declared source/version boundaries. Model instructions and structured checklists do not establish correctness.

tools.name: ToolUniverse
tools.documented_capability: Scientific tool catalogue and reusable literature-query/disambiguation workflows.
tools.verified_gap: The literature skill includes custom evidence tiers and model-generated appraisal aids; the PPI evidence-channel recommendation needs assay-level qualification. Neither source supplies curator truth labels.
tools.demonstrated_here: Pinned README/license, pyproject manifest, literature skill and protein-interaction skill source inspected; no installation, native tool execution or outcome comparison.
tools.decision: Reuse selected source adapters/procedures only after scope qualification. Do not install the full package into the frozen numerical environment or inherit its evidence judgments as biological truth.

dependency_constraint.consequence: Use a separate environment if adopting the complete package; do not alter the pinned scientific runtime.

tools.ppi_scope_qualification: The reviewed PPI skill recommends STRING experimental-channel escore for physical-binding evidence. We require assay-level/source-scope inspection before any direct-binding verdict; even STRING physical proximity can include indirect co-complex association.

tools.name: Biomni
tools.qualification_level: Primary paper plus pinned official README, license and named helper source inspected; no runtime/tool execution.
tools.documented_capability: Broad biomedical planning with code execution and a large scientific environment.
tools.remaining_unverified_gap: Transfer to the existing bounded Nemotron8B service, deployment cost, tool/data licensing and performance on our fixed tasks were not established.
tools.decision: Defer the broad platform runtime for this increment while retaining its existing PMID-preserving MCP example as a legitimate reusable alternative. Preserve exact query/source identity; do not create a custom fix based on the legacy helper alone.
tools.license: Apache-2.0 (pinned official LICENSE); integrated source data/tools retain their own terms
tools.demonstrated_here: Source inspection distinguishes legacy query_pubmed from a separate native typed-PMID MCP example. No live queries or new reference cases were opened.

helper_specific_findings.legacy_query_pubmed: On empty results, the published helper retries by removing trailing query words (default up to3retries). Its returned text contains title/abstract/journal, not the effective query or PMID.
helper_specific_findings.existing_PMID_preserving_alternative: The same revision contains a native PubMed MCP example with a typed Article.pmid search result and an exact-PMID abstract getter. The legacy helper limitation must not be generalized to all Biomni retrieval.
helper_specific_findings.know_how_inventory: The reviewed tree contains sgRNA-design and single-cell-annotation examples; this inventory is not evidence that no other biomedical workflows exist.

tools.name: GeneAgent

licenses.code: NLM United States Government Work public-domain notice
licenses.article: CC-BY-4.0; separately credited material and API/source data retain applicable terms

tools.documented_capability: Gene-set function generation with external database verification, modification and summarization; the paper masks matching GO/MSigDB resources to reduce answer leakage.
tools.demonstrated_here: Official code/prompts/license and exact archive metadata checked. Supplement2 sheet dimensions/headers only were inspected; its132 human outcome rows remained unopened.
tools.verified_gap: The132 claims from10 gene sets label correctness of the original verifier decision relative to report evidence, rather than independent support/refute truth of the biological claim. A self-contained raw source-response replay was not established. The archived/current worker specifies gpt-4o although paper Methods names GPT4-20230613.
tools.decision: HOLD as a scientific-accuracy/pruning reference. Reuse source selection and leakage-masking lessons; a report-correctness replay would require a separate explicit masked-input freeze.

tools.name: PathAnchor
tools.paper_license: arXiv perpetual non-exclusive distribution license; no code reuse permission inferred
tools.documented_capability: Bounded read-only inspection of source-linked Material-Sensor-Signal-System paths, with opened-evidence citation boundaries and a matched-resource representation comparison.
tools.verified_gap: The reviewed paper concerns flexible sensors and does not establish biomedical or8B-model transfer. No official executable/data release link was identified in the reviewed paper.
tools.demonstrated_here: Primary paper/method review only. The app already has source-bound evidence paths and exact native-source inspection; no separate PathAnchor implementation was added.
tools.decision: Retain its matched-access and opened-evidence lessons; do not duplicate existing app paths or reinterpret provenance paths as biological causality.

tools.name: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit
tools.documented_lifecycle: Deprecated as of October2026; end of life by end2026.

documented_migration_routes.Helix: Unified evaluation, optimization and hardening CLI

tools.boundary: The optional NAT orchestration wrapper is separate from the existing NVIDIA Nano model served through vLLM. The NAT notice does not establish end of life of that model endpoint.
tools.decision: Preserve the optional pinned wrapper for reproducibility; do not expand it into a new critical dependency or rewrite working delivery workflows now. Evaluate a supported migration only for a concrete lifecycle/capability need, separately from the fixed scientific comparisons.

tools.name: NVIDIA Agent Skills catalogue
tools.review_scope: Official catalogue README/licensing only; not qualification of every mirrored product skill.
tools.documented_capability: Portable product-specific coding guidance, including RAG deployment/evaluation and MCP-related workflows; individual skills are maintained in product repositories.
tools.remaining_gap: No biomedical-curator reference, biological accuracy improvement or compatibility with our specific runtime was established by this catalogue review.
tools.decision: Keep as an official product/version-specific reference. Do not install a broad skill catalogue or treat development guidance as a biological validator.

tools.name: MedCPT Cross-Encoder
tools.published_objective: Biomedical article relevance ranking; not biological truth or source-claim entailment.
tools.input_assumptions: Query paired with title plus abstract, scalar relevance logit, native max_length512. Native negative construction differs from a lexical-search candidate union.
tools.license_observation: Official code carries the NLM US government public-domain notice. HF model card declares public-domain; its LICENSE file is empty, so no additional license text is inferred.
tools.compatibility_status: Stock BERT appears compatible with existing Torch2.6/Transformers4.51.3; not demonstrated by loading.
tools.demonstrated_local_input_limit: Only the excluded manual Pharos TCRD capture was inspected: four titles and no abstract fields. One exact abstract-get cannot supply complete native inputs for the candidate union.
tools.metric_limit: Reordering at most10 retained papers cannot improve Recall@10.
tools.training_reference_overlap: Search logs span2020–2022; released BioASQ examples do not establish checkpoint fine-tuning membership or exclusion. No checksum-bound training-log membership manifest was found.
tools.decision: DEFER. A larger separately frozen retrieval pool and complete source abstracts would require a distinct source/budget assessment; no new index, data pipeline or experiment is added in this round.

published_global_diffusion_explanation.demonstrated_here: The published provenance and predictor normalization/Laplacian/solver equations match after version-stable AST normalization. Six invented native systems matched independent dense-inverse controls; residual, transpose and raw-score preservation checks passed.
published_global_diffusion_explanation.implementation_boundary: Unexecuted optional GPL research adapter preserved as investigation source, not an active product component. No external solver/normalization code copied or imported into the MIT app.
published_global_diffusion_explanation.scientific_boundary: Historical annotation-seed influence through global graph diffusion, not a causal path, independent experimental count, calibrated probability or new accuracy result.
published_global_diffusion_explanation.decision: Keep readiness optional. The separate predeclared full-comparison retention gate governs any later product use; no promotion is inferred from synthetic correctness.
